name: Dragon Village 3
storyline:
Long ago, after Maia Aora fell in the great war and Darknix emerged victorious, the world entered an age of darkness. As time passed, the warriors of the past and the true history of the war were forgotten, and Darknix came to be remembered only as a conqueror and destroyer.

However, throughout the world, records of memories left behind by ancient dragons still remained. Through these records, a truth different from the history people had come to know begins to emerge.

The Thunder Ancient Dragon, Glacier Ancient Dragon, and Power Dragon discover forgotten records within ancient ruins and learn that the Ancient Divine Dragon has been sealed away. The three dragons venture deep into the ruins to break the seal, but in the process, they come to realize that the history of Darknix’s victory and the war itself had been distorted.

The greatest revelation is that Darknix did not start the war of his own will, but was being controlled by an unknown entity. This raises the possibility that Darknix was not simply evil, but rather a being whose immense power had been exploited.

Afterward, the three dragons begin pursuing the shadowy force that controlled Darknix. They also learn that the Ancient Divine Dragon’s seal was not caused by Darknix, but by an even greater power behind the scenes.

In the end, they stand at a crossroads: should they break the seal and reveal the truth, or should they stop in order to prevent another catastrophe?
summary: Dragon Village 3 is a mobile collectible RPG centered on collecting, breeding, hatching, and raising dragons. Players can build and customize their own dragon village, develop a roster of dragons with different attributes, and take part in strategic battles based on elemental matchups and team composition. The game features real-time PvP, guild-based content, boss raids, and cooperative challenges, combining dragon-raising simulation elements with RPG progression and battle systems.
